comment: Board-local GPU inputs for the m2381 Adreno 740 lane (r131, 2026-11-16).
Everything here is either measured on this phone or read from its stock FDT; the
mainline sources (Linux a6xx driver/catalog, Mesa) stay pinned in
(.cache/firmware is ignored); these hashes and sizes are the pins the build refuses

provenance.dt: stock FDT of this phone (docs/hardware/stock-fdt.dts, /soc/qcom,kgsl-3d0@3d00000 qcom,gpu-pwrlevels-0 and qcom,gmu@3d69000 qcom,gmu-freq-table), translated to the upstream operating-points-v2 form; the upstream register windows come from the sm8550.dtsi of the pinned mainline tree (gpu 0x3d00000/0x40000, gmu 0x3d6a000/0x35000 + rscc 0x3d50000 + gmu_pdc 0xb280000, gpu SMMU 0x3da0000/0x40000; streams 0/1 GPU, 5 GMU)
provenance.firmware: nura vendor harvest 2026-10-30 (meizu20 vendor-root firmware, also meizu20_linux vendor-fw-harvest): a740_sqe.fw 2b49a172 and a740_zap.mbn 3cc594a0 differ from sheng's signed blobs; gmu_gen70200.bin 1a2a419c is byte-identical to sheng/the mainline pin
